correctness.rationale: For factor length k<=m, noncrossing factors survive in w; crossing factors lose an inserted zero, become length k-1 factors in w, and extend to k factors dominated by the original prefix. For k>=m+1, every factor and prefix crosses the center, and deleting the zero compares their respective k-1 factors in w. This is a quantified proof for every m>=1; center deletion is an inverse on images and all-ones word is outside. Independent enumeration of all palindromes for m=1,...,8 checked prefix-normality, image injectivity and strictness; counts (even,odd) through m=8: (2,3),(3,5),(4,8),(7,12),(11,21),(18,36),(31,57),(55,104).
